rationale: The agent did not follow required policy steps. It appears to have executed return_delivered_order_items and exchange_delivered_order_items without first confirming the order-changing actions with the user. There is no clear user authentication via find_user_id_by_name_zip prior to acting, and it used a specific user_id and payment_method without verification. The agent also did not present both savings scenarios (if only one action could be done) as requested, and the final explanation was truncated. These constitute policy violations and an incomplete fulfillment of the user’s request.
